sections.h2: What AI customer service should do

blocks.text: An **AI customer service agent** on your website and app that answers routine questions around the clock, completes account tasks through the BSS and hands complex cases to people.

Contact centers are flooded with routine modem, billing and plan questions. Support stops at office hours. Markets are multilingual. **AI customer service for telecom** has to answer from the customer's own account and plan, which an FAQ page cannot do.

items.q: What is an AI virtual agent?
items.a: An **AI virtual agent** answers customer questions in natural language, on web or app, and can complete simple tasks on the customer's behalf.

items.q: Can it make changes to a customer's account?
items.a: Yes, through the BSS and only inside the signed-in customer's own account.
The assistant hands them to a contact-center agent, with the conversation so far.

blocks.text: The AI Customer Assistant has been live with subscribers since January 2024. It is built into Selfcare Now (beta) and sold with Alepo self-care and BSS. Complex cases go to people. It works on web and app alike, and answers come from the signed-in customer's own account. When a case goes to a care agent, the full conversation goes with it, so the subscriber does not repeat the question and the agent starts from the same account data. In-chat offers, such as a speed boost, come only from the plans the operator sells.
